name: todo-webapp

dependencies.description: Backend API for managing todo lists, todo items, and list sharing/collaboration.
dependencies.name: todo-api

dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used by the SPA to sign users in and obtain tokens for calling todo-api.
dependencies.name: user-auth

description: React single-page app where a signed-in user views their own and shared todo lists, manages list items with due dates, and manages sharing/collaborators on lists they own. Calls todo-api for all data; does not persist anything itself and holds no secrets.
